meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: You MUST use this before any creative work - creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior. Explores user intent, requirements and design before implementation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 先把要做什么聊透,再动手实现,少走返工路
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果准备做新功能却还没想清楚到底要什么
copy.tagline_en: Talk through what to build before writing any code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to build a feature but haven't pinned down what it should do

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在任何创作工作前会先停下:把请求分成 spike、有界(bounded)、架构(architectural)三类并说出分类,问清意图与约束,给出设计并等你明确同意后才开始实现。
howto.when: 当你要开发新功能、新建组件或修改现有行为等创作类工作时接管流程;原文写明这是硬性要求(MUST),没有先完成该路径的设计审批就不进入实现。

say.text: 我想加一个新功能,先别写代码,帮我理清需求
say.note: 它会先说出分类,并一次只问一个澄清问题

say.text: 这个改动算有界还是架构级?先说你的分类
say.note: 它会当场说明走哪条路径,你可以推翻

say.text: 做个可行性探针:我们能不能用 X 实现 Y?
say.note: 它先给 2-3 句探针计划,点头后才去查

howto.what_en: After installing, before any creative work Claude stops first: it sorts the request into spike, bounded, or architectural, says the classification out loud, asks about intent and constraints, presents a design, and waits for your approval before implementing.
howto.when_en: It takes over before any creative work — new features, components, or changed behavior. The skill says it MUST be used first, so implementation waits until that path's design is approved.

say_en.text: I want to add a new feature; don't write code yet — help me pin down the requirements
say_en.note: It states the path and asks one clarifying question at a time

say_en.text: Is this change bounded or architectural? State your classification first
say_en.note: It names the path out loud; you can override it

say_en.text: Spike: can we do Y with X?
say_en.note: It gives a 2-3 sentence probe plan, then investigates
